definitions.explanation: A specific matter, topic, or incident under discussion or consideration. Often used to refer back to something previously mentioned.

definitions.gloss: counter for cases, incidents, or items
definitions.explanation: A counter used for incidents, cases, complaints, applications, and similar discrete items or occurrences.

examples.japanese: その{件|けん}については{後|あと}で{話|はな}しましょう。
メールの{件|けん}でお{電話|でんわ}しました。
examples.english: I'm calling regarding the matter in the email.

examples.japanese: {例|れい}の{件|けん}は{部長|ぶちょう}に{確認|かくにん}してからお{返事|へんじ}します。
examples.english: I'll get back to you about that matter after confirming with the department head.

examples.japanese: {苦情|くじょう}が{三|さん}{件|けん}{入|はい}った。
{今月|こんげつ}は{問|と}い{合|あ}わせが{五十|ごじゅう}{件|けん}あった。
examples.english: There were fifty inquiries this month.

examples.japanese: {昨年|さくねん}の{交通|こうつう}{事故|じこ}は{約|やく}{一万|いちまん}{件|けん}{報告|ほうこく}されている。
examples.english: Approximately ten thousand traffic accidents were reported last year.

notes:
As a noun, {件|けん} is often used with demonstratives: その{件|けん} (that matter), この{件|けん} (this matter), {例|れい}の{件|けん} (that matter we discussed).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・その{件|けん} (that matter)
・{例|れい}の{件|けん} (the matter in question)
・〜の{件|けん}で (regarding the matter of...)
・{何|なん}{件|けん} (how many cases)

COUNTER USAGE:
As a counter, {件|けん} has no sound changes. It counts:
・{事件|じけん} (incidents), {事故|じこ} (accidents)
・{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ (inquiries), {苦情|くじょう} (complaints)
・{申|もう}し{込|こ}み (applications), {契約|けいやく} (contracts)

COUNTING PATTERN:
1: {一|いっ}{件|けん}　2: {二|に}{件|けん}　3: {三|さん}{件|けん}　4: {四|よん}{件|けん}　5: {五|ご}{件|けん}
6: {六|ろく}{件|けん}　7: {七|なな}{件|けん}　8: {八|はち}{件|けん}　9: {九|きゅう}{件|けん}　10: {十|じゅっ}{件|けん}
